items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Tom Albert used to come down all the time and play music.

ctx.x: Who were some of the people that came down there?
Well, Tom Albert used to come down all the time and play music. Tom Albert, he was well known, come down and play music.
